title: Complete roadmap P2.3–P4.3: accessibility, performance benchmarks, view robustness, snapshot tests, Storybook edge cases, TypeDoc setup
body:
Addresses remaining unchecked items across ROADMAP P2.3–P4.3 with concrete deliverables: ARIA attributes, test coverage, Storybook stories, and documentation infrastructure.

### Build fix
- Remove unused imports in 4 console test files (`waitFor`, `expect`, `act`, `beforeEach`, `container`, `matchMediaListeners`) that caused TS6133 build failures

### P2.3 Accessibility
- **Kanban**: Add `role="region"`, `role="group"`, `role="list"`, `role="listitem"`, `aria-label`, `aria-live="assertive"` for drag overlay
- **Calendar**: Add `role="grid"`, `role="gridcell"`, `role="columnheader"`, `aria-current="date"`, `aria-label` on nav buttons, events, and cells across Month/Week/Day views
- **WCAG contrast tests**: Programmatic HSL→luminance→contrast-ratio verification for all foreground/background pairs in both light and dark themes

### P2.4 Performance
- Kanban benchmarks: 100/500/1000 cards, 20+ columns, badge-heavy cards
- Calendar benchmarks: 100/500/1000 events, multi-day spans, month/day views

### P3.2 Field widget extreme inputs
- Tests for 10K-char strings, `MAX_SAFE_INTEGER`, ZWJ emoji sequences, Hebrew RTL, XSS payloads (`<script>`, SQL injection), `undefined`/empty handling

### P3.3 View robustness
- Kanban view states: empty columns, WIP limit exceeded, 50-card single column
- Calendar view states: empty events, month boundary, leap year, cross-month spans
- E2E Playwright specs for grid→detail→back, kanban rendering, calendar navigation, view switching

### P3.4 Test coverage
- Form validation + submit integration tests (required field validation, inline errors, reset, error callback)
- Snapshot tests for Button (6 variants + sizes), Badge (4 variants), Card, Empty, Spinner

### P3.5 Storybook edge cases
- 9 component stories (empty states, spinners, overflow text, RTL layout)
- 5 grid stories (empty, single row, 18 columns, long values, nulls)
- 5 kanban stories (empty board, WIP limit, long titles, 12 columns)

### P4.2–P4.3 Documentation infrastructure
- `typedoc.json` + `docs:api` script for markdown API reference generation from 6 core packages
- Storybook GitHub Pages deployment workflow (on push to `main`, scoped to `packages/` changes)
- `GettingStarted.mdx` living documentation in Storybook

### CalendarView bug fix
- `locale` prop was not passed through to `WeekView`, causing it to fall back to browser default
